Troutdale, Oregon

Junk removal in Troutdale

Troutdale sits right at the mouth of the Gorge, a short run up I-84 from our base, which keeps it in the home zone. We pick up from the older homes near the historic downtown, the newer streets climbing toward Strebin Farms, and the townhomes close to the outlet center.

Plenty of Troutdale jobs follow a move: furniture that did not fit the new place, a garage full of boxes, or a basement cleared before a sale. River weekends leave their own leftovers too, like old kayaks, coolers past saving and broken patio sets.

Troutdale questions

Good to know

Can you clear a Troutdale garage before an open house?

Yes. Book a day before the listing photos, send a picture of the garage, and we will empty it and sweep the floor so it photographs clean.

Do you take old boats or kayaks?

Kayaks, canoes and small rowboats, yes. Boats with motors or on trailers need a hand quote, so call or text us with a photo.

Is there a travel charge to Troutdale?

No. Troutdale is in our home zone, close to our base in Gresham, so there is no travel charge.

Which Troutdale ZIP codes do you cover?

All of these: 97060. Type yours in the quote and the price includes travel.
